scope: Simulation stress testing, not human win-rate estimates

guardianRevision.note: Frost final 8-case retest replaces earlier Frost rows. Each guardian has only 8 controller cases: not a reliable population rate.

limitations: Controllers use visible geometry and approximate prediction; they remain better informed than people.
150/250ms delays, 40/70ms timing jitter, seeded missed pickups and missed powers are explicit synthetic assumptions.
Economy inventories model stochastic pickup and collision outcomes, not geometric play.
Small per-level samples identify candidates for playtesting, not exact difficulty rankings.
High-tier flight diagnostics used a minimal build, so their failures do not establish balanced endgame difficulty.
Early economy runs had a stale length multiplier and were discarded; only economy-release uses the corrected production length and Collector constants.
Overflow income still snowballs with skillful play; no claim of globally optimal or non-dominant builds.
